description: Returns check history (status, response time, message), newest first, keyed by monitor ID: for one monitor when monitorID is given, otherwise for every monitor. Only the latest beat per monitor is returned unless maxHeartbeats is set (up to 100; keep it at 10 or less for one monitor and 5 or less for all, unless asked for more). important: true returns only the status changes for one monitor, which is history and not the current status. For current status use getMonitorSummary. Credentials inside a message URL read "***" unless includeSecrets is set.

important.description: Return only IMPORTANT beats — the status changes behind Uptime Kuma's event list — fetched live from the server rather than the cache. Needs monitorID. History only: the newest important beat is not the monitor's current status.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***". Off by default: this output is persisted in conversation transcripts and logs. Can also be enabled globally with UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS=true.

maxHeartbeats.description: How many of the most recent beats to return per monitor, up to 100 (default: 1)

monitorID.description: The monitor to read. Omit for every monitor. Find IDs with listMonitors.

name: listHeartbeats

time.description: Timestamp, in UTC as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS". Uptime Kuma sends no zone marker, so compare against the current UTC time, not local time.

heartbeats.description: Map of monitor IDs to their heartbeats, newest first

title: List Heartbeats
